subject.title: [Feature]: Expose an inbound non-message event hook to external channel plugins (e.g. reactions)

question: Should external channel plugins surface non-message activity through the existing system-event/channel-runtime APIs, or should OpenClaw add a new public channel event hook or adapter contract?
rationale: The current code exposes partial primitives, but choosing a documented recipe versus a new SDK hook affects third-party plugin compatibility and overlaps with the open inbound_activity proposal.

options.title: Document Current Primitives
options.body: Treat reactions, edits, and receipts as channel-owned system events with an explicit heartbeat/session-routing recipe, and add code only for gaps that recipe cannot cover.

options.title: Sponsor A Generic Event Contract
options.body: Define a typed Plugin SDK event hook or adapter for non-message inbound activity, then align Discord and external channel examples around that contract.

options.title: Defer Pending Plugin Proof
options.body: Ask for a minimal Zoho Cliq plugin sketch showing why system events and runtime.channel.inbound.run cannot satisfy the use case before changing SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Document Current Primitives
recommendation.body: Treat reactions, edits, and receipts as channel-owned system events with an explicit heartbeat/session-routing recipe, and add code only for gaps that recipe cannot cover.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current provenance for the channel inbound/runtime SDK surfaces points to steipete, and the decision is primarily about plugin API direction.
